events.name: Bash
events.head: Check snapshot, log line, and job status
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; date; ls pipeline/snapshots/; grep -n "PIPELINE WEEKLY SNAPSHOT" coord/LOG.md | tail -3; launchctl list | grep pipeline-weekly; grep -A3 ProgramArguments ops/com.tantra.pipeline-weekly.plist | head; grep -n -A6 StandardOut ops/com.tantra.pipeline-weekly.plist | head -8
